description:
Rebalance the existing portfolio (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA) to an equal-weight allocation. 

Starting State: You have a portfolio with 3 positions: Apple (AAPL), Microsoft (MSFT), and NVIDIA (NVDA). 

Goal: 
1. Analyze the portfolio to determine necessary trades to make each position approximately equal in value (approx. $17,542.50 per stock).
2. Record the necessary transactions in JStock:
   - Sell excess AAPL shares (Target: Sell 5 shares @ ~$185.20)
   - Sell excess MSFT shares (Target: Sell 3 shares @ ~$374.50)
   - Buy more NVDA shares (Target: Buy 3 shares @ ~$615.30)
   *Note: Use the current date for all transactions.*
3. Create a text report at `/home/ga/Documents/rebalancing_report.txt` documenting the trades (include symbols and actions 'Buy'/'Sell').
